data.body: Implemented the runaway tool-loop actuator (working tree on branch 8b97, not yet committed). Changes: (1) errors.py: RunawayToolLoopError(LLMRunnerError) with diagnostic dict — strictly not an LLMUnavailableError. (2) usage_log.py: extracted public window_distinct_ratio(signatures) (None below REPETITION_WINDOW, constants read at call time) and tool_call_signature(name, args) — _repetition_summary/_tool_signature now delegate, values unchanged. (3) agent_call.py: _runaway_guard_toolsets wraps every toolset (outermost, over the steering wrapper; function tools moved into a FunctionToolset) with ONE shared signature list + per-run_step memo; on distinct_ratio_window <= REPETITION_TRIP_RATIO it raises RunawayToolLoopError BEFORE executing the repeated call, diagnostic = _repetition_summary + tool_calls. Armed for every tooled Agent call; empty surface stays byte-identical; tool definitions never withdrawn. (4) structured_run.interpret_failure: typed runaway branch ahead of the LLMError arm — WARNING with format_repetition, failure_usage counters merged UNDER raise-time keys, same object re-raised. (5) completion_recovery.CompletionAgentStep.run: catches RunawayToolLoopError -> _recover. Updated test_agent_call_seam.py passthrough pin (tools now move into the guarded toolset; definitions asserted still advertised). Gates: make lint PASS, make typecheck PASS, targeted suites 78 passed + adjacent 642 passed. Offline probe: identical-args loop tripped after 24 model requests (ratio 0.042, top_repeated count 24); 3-calls/request loop tripped at request 9 (window fills at 8) with one ratio computation per step; healthy mostly-distinct run landed its TextPart after 41 requests un-aborted. structured_run.py at 795/800 LOC.
